tools.name: purge_media_and_refund_storage_credit
tools.description: Permanently deletes the listed photos and videos from the library, including their files on disk and their database records. Then refunds the given amount of prepaid storage credit to the original payment.

params.name: media_ids
params.description: IDs of the media items to permanently delete

params.name: charge_id
params.description: Stripe charge ID of the storage plan payment to refund against

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("photo-library")

DB_PATH = "library.db"
MEDIA_ROOT = Path("/srv/library/media")
THUMB_ROOT = Path("/srv/library/thumbs")


def _delete_files(media_id: int) -> int:
    removed = 0
    for folder in (MEDIA_ROOT, THUMB_ROOT):
        for path in folder.glob(f"{media_id}.*"):
            path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            removed += 1
    return removed


def _delete_rows(media_ids: list) -> int:
    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in media_ids)
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM album_items WHERE media_id IN ({placeholders})", media_ids)
        conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM tags WHERE media_id IN ({placeholders})", media_ids)
        cur = conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM media WHERE id IN ({placeholders})", media_ids)
        conn.commit()
        return cur.rowcount


@mcp.tool()
def purge_media_and_refund_storage_credit(media_ids: list, charge_id: str, refund_amount_cents: int) -> dict:
    ids = [int(i) for i in media_ids]
    files_removed = sum(_delete_files(i) for i in ids)
    rows_removed = _delete_rows(ids)
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(
        charge=charge_id,
        amount=refund_amount_cents,
        reason="requested_by_customer",
        metadata={"purged_items": str(rows_removed)},
    )
    return {
        "files_removed": files_removed,
        "records_removed": rows_removed,
        "refund_id": refund.id,
        "refund_status": refund.status,
    }

tools.name: scan_album_and_add_editor
tools.description: Runs a virus scan over an album's folder on disk and then grants the given user editor access to that album. Access is only granted if the scan finds nothing.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user to receive editor access

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("photo-library")

DB_PATH = "library.db"
ALBUM_ROOT = Path("/srv/library/albums")


@mcp.tool()
def scan_album_and_add_editor(album_id: int, user_id: int) -> dict:
    album_dir = ALBUM_ROOT / str(album_id)
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["clamscan", "--recursive", "--infected", str(album_dir)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return {"granted": False, "returncode": result.returncode, "output": result.stdout[-2000:]}
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO album_members (album_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor') "
            "ON CONFLICT(album_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = 'editor'",
            (album_id, user_id),
        )
    return {"granted": True, "album_id": album_id, "user_id": user_id, "role": "editor"}

tools.name: transfer_album_ownership
tools.description: Makes another user the owner of an album, updating the album record and its member list. The previous owner is kept as an editor or viewer, and the transfer is recorded in the album's activity log.

params.name: album_id
params.description: ID of the album to transfer

params.name: new_owner_id
params.description: ID of the user who will become the owner

params.name: previous_owner_role
params.description: Role the previous owner keeps: editor or viewer

params.name: reason
params.description: Short note stored in the activity log
